highlights: The desktop app now opens with a licence window, like LightBurn's: start a 30-day trial or enter your licence key. KerfDesk Free stays in the browser, and paid licences keep working offline.
New free tools: a G-code Inspector, your computer's installed fonts, inch display units, and running a G-code file made in another program.

Machine Setup starts with one machine list, Start shows a compact confirm sheet you can edit in place, and the artwork hover readout shows power and speed. The Falcon A1 Pro's red pointer switches on with one tick.
Controllers behave more safely: jog cancel waits for the machine's reply, failed auto-connects stay quiet, the safety notice and recovery card float over the canvas, and alarms are read per firmware.

Trace an image already on the Registration Jig. Centre & LED keeps the pointer light on until you press LED off, dither swatches appear wherever you pick a dither, and canvas text is laid out in the background.

The Artwork panel is tidier, collapsed panels breathe gently, the hover pulse stays smooth with many pieces, kerf offsets judge inner and outer edges more reliably, and the loading screen no longer pops in.
